name: Link and Unlink company with contact and deal
description: Link and Unlink company with contact and deal. Link or unlink contacts and deals with a specific company in a single request. You can simultaneously link new contacts/deals and unlink existing ones by providing the respective ID arrays in the request body.

linkContactIds.description: Contact ids for contacts to be linked with company

linkDealsIds.description: Deal ids for deals to be linked with company

unlinkContactIds.description: Contact ids for contacts to be unlinked from company

unlinkDealsIds.description: Deal ids for deals to be unlinked from company
